description: This file defines a logger class for integrating with Logfire, including methods for configuring logging, creating span configurations based on payloads, and logging events with detailed metadata. It is specific to the 'logfire_logger.py' component within the project.

classes.name: SpanConfig
classes.description: NamedTuple for span configuration containing message template and span data.

classes.name: LogfireLevel
classes.description: Enum for log levels, with 'info' and 'error' as options.

classes.name: LogfireLogger
classes.description: Main class responsible for configuring and sending log events to Logfire, including methods for creating span configs and logging events.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LogfireLogger, configuring the logfire client if enabled.

methods.name: _get_span_config
methods.description: Determines the span configuration based on the payload's call type.

methods.name: _async_log_event
methods.description: Asynchronous wrapper to call log_event with provided parameters.

methods.name: log_event
methods.description: Logs an event to Logfire with detailed metadata, handling different log levels and cleaning sensitive info.
